features.desc: Local-first by default, bring your own keys, and an ecosystem that grows with you — three reasons one-person companies choose xopc.

items.title: Bring your own keys. Any model.
items.body: DeepSeek, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, Bedrock, Azure — 20+ providers built in. Run fully offline with local inference, or mix cloud and local as you please. Zero vendor lock-in. Switch models in one config line.

items.title: One brain, every screen
items.body: The same assistant — in your terminal, browser, desktop app, phone, and messengers. No sync needed. It's all one system.

items.title: Dynamic workflows
items.body: Fan-out isolated subagents from deterministic scripts — repo audits, multi-perspective reviews, and parallel research. Each run gets its own session with live progress.

items.title: Multi-agent routing
items.body: Route different contexts to different agents — each with its own model, workspace, tools, and system prompt. Fully isolated contexts for work, creativity, and code.

items.title: Grows with you. Never outgrow it.
items.body: Install Skills with one command. Add Extensions for new tools, channels, and UI panels. Multi-agent routing for different contexts. It's your system — shape it. xopc skills install · xopc extensions install — and it just works.

items.title: Your machine. Your rules.
items.body: xopc runs on your hardware. Conversations stay local. API keys stay in your config. No mandatory cloud, no surprise bills, no data leaving without your say. ~/.xopc/ — everything in one directory you own.

items.title: HTTP/SSE gateway
items.body: REST JSON APIs plus Server-Sent Events for streaming and live updates, with the same React console you get in Electron. Open the URL from logs or gateway config.

items.title: Type-Safe Tool System
items.body: Build custom tools with TypeBox schemas. Web search, browser control (Playwright, opt-in), file operations — extend your agent's capabilities.

items.title: Voice & vision
items.body: STT/TTS where configured — e.g. Telegram and gateway paths. Images: vision plus generation when you wire it up; see the Voice and Tools docs.
